remediation: CT step now runs as a hard gate when CDISC_LIBRARY_API_KEY is configured and reports the skip explicitly otherwise; add a conformance-coverage summary step; keep the full CORE run documented as a data-bearing local gate; verified 2026-08-05.

evidence: A local gitignored .core_run/.env carries CDISC_LIBRARY_API_KEY for local runs, but GitHub Actions cannot read local files; the key must be added as a repository secret for the CI CT gate to become a hard check. Until then, CT cross-validation in CI remains an explicit, visible SKIP.
standard_or_rule: External dependency; CI conformance enforcement
remediation: Add CDISC_LIBRARY_API_KEY as a GitHub repository secret (same value as .core_run/.env) to turn the CI CT gate into a hard check; accepted for data-free CI until then.
disposition_note: 2026-08-05 accepted external dependency; local key present in .core_run/.env
column12: CI enforcement requires GitHub repo secret

evidence: Gitleaks existed only as a local pre-commit hook; the GitHub Actions workflow had no secret scan.
standard_or_rule: Security hygiene; credential leakage prevention
remediation: Add a pinned gitleaks v8.18.4 scan step to the validate job; verified 2026-08-05.

evidence: R used r-version 'release' and Python CI dependencies were installed unpinned.
standard_or_rule: Reproducibility/change control
remediation: Pin R to 4.6.0 (the audited release) and add requirements-ci.txt with top-level pins for the CI Python toolchain; a full transitive lockfile is tracked as future work; verified 2026-08-05.

evidence: The workflow lacked a permissions restriction, concurrency control, job timeouts, and manual dispatch.
standard_or_rule: GitHub Actions hygiene
remediation: Add permissions: contents: read, a concurrency group with cancel-in-progress, timeout-minutes, and workflow_dispatch; verified 2026-08-05.
